estimate.damage_summary: An atmospheric overvoltage damaged the speaker system and TV connected to the building installation. A technician later checked the surge failure and wiring safety.
estimate.policy_notes: The damaged electronics are covered for lightning-related overvoltage, subject to the EUR 5,000 gross appliance sub-limit and the no-improvement standard. Because no surge-protective device was used, indemnity for the appliances is halved. The policy excludes arrangement/order charges and, in the circumstances described in clause 11.2, the attendance charge on that provider invoice; the supplied invoice instead identifies an electronics retailer.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: Both appliances are reported as physically damaged by the covered surge and are plausibly represented by the two invoiced pieces. The reasonable price is for standard-grade equivalents, without a premium upgrade; the likely combined value remains below the appliance sub-limit, before the required 50% reduction.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: The visit is plausibly connected to confirming the surge failure and checking wiring safety, but the invoice's three-piece quantity is not supported by the description of one technician attendance. The policy excludes the attendance charge on the arrangement/provider invoice described in clause 11.2; the supplied invoice is identified as a retailer invoice, so whether that specific exclusion applies to this line is uncertain. If valid, a modest single attendance and diagnostic charge is reasonable.
